summary: WF-06 · Monarch YT Agent Crew structure delivered (commit 1a7a526). Eight agents: A01 MANAGER, A02 HUNTER (research/ideas), A03 ARCHITECT (script), A04 VOICE, A05 CRAFTSMAN (edit), A06 PACKAGER (title/thumb/metadata), plus two added to close fatal gaps: A07 WARDEN (compliance/rights, veto) and A08 ORACLE (analytics/learning loop). Pipeline S0-S8 with measured gates, live reporting bus, numbered manager feedback, 3-strike escalation, 8-point rubric with Uniqueness-under-4-means-KILL. No code written per explicit instruction. Validation 21 pass / 0 error.
next_action: Implement WF-06 as running agents (code) after user sign-off, OR begin S0 BRIEF on CLOSE CALL FILES #01 using RUNBOOK_S01E01.md. Two open blockers: YouTube Studio analytics access for A08 and the human publish gate.
